reason: I already pay an admin who types receipts into Excel every week. It's slow and always behind, but it works well enough, and I'm not paying another monthly fee for a bot to do part of the same job.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does. It doesn't fix the real problem anyway, which is that half the receipts never get sent to the chat in the first place.
would_change_my_mind: If my accountant said they'd take the Google Sheet as-is and it cut their month-end chasing, or if it freed up enough of my admin's hours that I could see the savings myself.
